As he turned to tend the wick, a glint of amber caught his eye near the wave-dashed rocks. Down the winding stone stairs he hurried, lantern in hand. Wedged between two barnacled boulders lay a green glass bottle, sealed tight with red wax. Silas stared into the howling dark, clutching the glass as a cold shiver ran down his spine.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，褪去了白日的喧嚣，披上一层薄如蝉翼的晨雾。路灯在空旷的街道上投下昏黄而寂寥的光影，偶尔有环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响，打破了夜的寂静。远处的写字楼里，零星几盏窗户还亮着不灭的灯火，不知是哪位夜归人或奋斗者的身影。空气中带着一丝清冽的水汽，深吸一口，满是黎明前的宁静。整座城市仿佛陷入了沉沉的梦乡，但在那厚重的夜色之下，新的一天正悄然酝酿着勃勃生机。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- It always needs a base case to stop calling itself, otherwise it will run forever.\n- Think of it like looking into two facing mirrors, where each reflection gets smaller and smaller until it reaches the end."}
